channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ray Allen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ray Allen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Bobby Portis on being a Heat fan his whole life, and conversations he had with Giannis about coming to Miami:

“I’ve been a Heatle. I’ve been rocking with the Heat since the Mavericks and the Spurs in the finals. Ray Allen in the corner, Chris Bosh offensive rebound, pass out to the corner, bow! Everybody thought it was over with the ropes out. The conversations I had with Giannis has just always been about winning. Where can we go to win? How can we get another championship? Once you guys talk to him at 3 you’ll understand all he cares about is winning.”

Bobby Portis on Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kon Knueppel on Ray Allen
item.description:
Kon Knueppel:

“Ray Allen. I don’t shoot really anything like him. But he was one of my favorite players just because he could shoot the hell out of it. He was one of my favorites.”

Kon Knueppel on Ray Allen, Jul 16, 2025. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Marco Belinelli on Ray Allen, Gregg Popovich
item.description:
Marco Belinelli:

“In San Antonio, I found the perfect situation with Gregg Popovich, with a European-style team. They had just lost the NBA Finals to Miami — the famous Ray Allen corner shot. On the first day of training camp, they made us sit and watch the last two quarters where they lost the title. Pop said: 'This is where we start from. We have to build from here and never make those mistakes again.' That was my moment to fully commit.”

Marco Belinelli on Ray Allen, Gregg Popovich, Apr 26, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Ray Allen
item.description:
Stephen Jackson:

“I didn’t have a better career than Ray Allen, but if you look at the games I played against a lot of these people, I balled out against them. We might not have won the game, but in my matchups with a lot of these people who y’all look up to, I bust their ass a lot of nights and locked them up. I didn’t have better careers than them, but I was a competitor. I wasn’t a better shooter than Ray, but I was a better post player, a better passer, a better defender—betterat a lot of things on the court. People don’t understand that. As a fan, they just think it’s hating. But I did it in real time.”

Stephen Jackson on Ray Allen, Nov 18, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“I grew up watching a lot of Ray Allen, JJ Redick, and Kyle Korver. Obviously, Steph [Curry] and Klay [Thompson] have kind of revolutionized the 3-point shot as well,”

Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Jan 3, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Ray Allen
item.description:
Curry quickly named Ray Allen as the one who is as deserving as him for the honor, noting that the Boston Celtics legend and iconic marksman has achieved so much in his career.

“I'd say Ray Allen. I think his form, his dedication to his craft, hit big shots in his career,”

Stephen Curry on Ray Allen, Jul 31, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Paul George on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Doc Rivers
item.description:
Paul George on his struggles in Doc Rivers' system:

“Doc was trying to play me as a Ray Allen or a JJ Redick, all pin-downs. I can do it, but that ain't my game. I need some flow, I need some mixes of some pick-and-roll, and post ups... That last season was hard.”

Paul George on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Doc Rivers, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Ray Allen
item.description:
“Most guys who are role players, they kind of stick in their role. He’s playing like Ray Allen,”

Kenny Atkinson on Ray Allen, Dec 1, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Ray Allen, Steve Kerr, Larry Bird, Reggie Miller
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Klay Thompson:

“What is somebody going to tell me about my jump shot that I can’t fix? Unless it’s Reggie Miller or Ray Allen, I don’t know who I’m supposed to listen to. Larry Bird? Steve Kerr. I’ll listen to Steve. Steve shot 45 percent.”

Klay Thompson on Ray Allen, Steve Kerr, Larry Bird, Reggie Miller, Dec 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“Your dad, [Doc Rivers], was an NBA coach, you've been able to work out with Paul Pierce and [Kevin Garnett] and Ray Allen and all that. We felt like you had the upperhand. He had the NBA socks when we were playing. We were thinking about all of this stuff. You had access to all this stuff and we didn't. We were kind of envious of it. His game was like super far advanced from everybody else; his handle, his floater, everything. In a way, we were like 'man, this dude.' We were kind of jealous of him for a little bit.”

Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett, Sep 28, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Ray Allen
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Doc Rivers on Ray Allen + 2008 Celtics:

“Things have been fractured and I hate it. I hate seeing it. I would love this [Hall of Fame week to be a] celebration for Ray. ... Ray won us a title. He really did. I think he should be celebrated. He should be celebrated in Boston.”

Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Sep 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
in Boston started so well … Doc Rivers:

“I thought they were ready, for one. I thought, No. 2, Kevin (Garnett), was the key to it. The problem when you have three scorers is somebody is always going to get less. Two guys are probably going to get the same or a little less and one guy is going to get a lot less. You can look at Miami, it was (Chris) Bosh. With us, at times it was Ray (Allen), at times it was KG, but I thought KG was key because early on he literally gave up his offensive game. He just said ‘I’ll be the defensive captain, you guys do all the scoring.’”

Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Kevin Garnett, Nov 10, 2017. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Ray Allen
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Paul Pierce on Ray Allen:

“A lot of the little things (he was going through in Boston with trade rumors) I didn't understand.”

Paul Pierce on Ray Allen, Oct 16, 2017. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Ray Allen
item.description:
“Well, I knew I was going to see Ray. When we did the Area 21 and we addressed the whole Ray Allen situation and reunion and our relationship and how it all kind of fell apart, the one thing I said to the guys also, I said, man, at some point we’re going to have to end all this. Ray was a big part of what we accomplished. So we’ve got to eventually get over this,”

Paul Pierce on Ray Allen, Oct 16, 2017. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
LeBron James:

“So, it's going to be very challenging. Those guys are going to challenge me. They're going to challenge our ballclub. This is a high-powered teamand I've played against some other (stiff competition). I've played against Ray (Allen), KG (Kevin Garnett), Paul (Pierce), (Rajon) Rondo and Doc (Rivers). So, it's going to be very challenging not only on me mentally, but on our ballclub and on our franchise.”

LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett, May 28, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Glen Davis on Ray Allen
item.description:
“I just think when Rondo started to appear and started to [say], ‘Hey, here I am,’ it wasn’t a mutual, ‘Hey, this is our new shining star’ with Ray. It was more, ‘Hey, this is K.G., Paul, Ray Allen’s team.’ And I just feel like it could have been stopped. Whatever that [was], it could have been stopped.”

Glen Davis on Ray Allen, Mar 24, 2017. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Ray Allen
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Wade:

“No one helped us out in Miami. (Ray Allen) was free agency, less money. They weren’t sending anybody to us. No one gave us a gift.”

Dwyane Wade on Ray Allen, Jan 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Ray Allen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Wade on Ray Allen retirement:

“I thank Ray Allen. The Game 6 shot that he hit saved our butts in Miami. I’ve always been a fan of Ray.”

Dwyane Wade on Ray Allen, Nov 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Ray Allen
item.description:
Spurs coach Gregg Popovich on Ray Allen, who announced his retirement on Tuesday:

“He was one of the great ones, one of the best shooters of all time, played with class, competed through his whole career. He cared about his community, helluva guy.”

Gregg Popovich on Ray Allen, Nov 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Ray Allen
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Isaiah on Ray Allen's retirement:

“He's a Hall of Famer. One of the best shooters ever. It was great to watch him as a young kid growing up”

Isaiah Thomas on Ray Allen, Nov 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Ray Allen
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Rajon Rondo on Ray Allen:

“I thought he'd been retired? He had a hell of a career.”

Rajon Rondo on Ray Allen, Nov 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Jason Richardson on Ray Allen
item.description:
Jason Richardson:

“[Laughs] Yeah. If he doesn't do it in the first game he'll do it in the second. When it's all said and done, if he can stay healthy, he'll probably be the greatest shooter of all time. In my mind Ray Allen is still the greatest shooter but the way Steph is shooting the ball he'll end up the first on three-points made and he'll probably go down as the greatest shooter in NBA history.”

Jason Richardson on Ray Allen, Oct 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @BarriHoopsHype.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Ray Allen
item.description:
Jovan Buha:Doc Rivers on Ray Allen's possible retirement:

“I know he's a plus-one, but I haven't talked to him about it.”

Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Dec 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Ray Allen
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:More Wade on Allen/Cavs prospect:

“They're taking what we did here & trying to duplicate it there. That means we did something right here.”

Dwyane Wade on Ray Allen, Oct 7, 2014. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Pat Riley on Ray Allen
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Pat Riley on re-signing Ray Allen:

“We haven’t moved on. I’ve been told he has not made a decision at all about anything.”

Pat Riley on Ray Allen, Jul 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @PBPjasonlieser.

item.title: Bruce Bowen on Ray Allen
item.description:
Bruce Bowen:

“There was only one time when I hurt a player on purpose. I kicked Ray Allen in the back when he was playing with the Seattle SuperSonics. He was in front of me and when I kicked him I thought: 'what have I done?' I regret it so much.”

Bruce Bowen on Ray Allen, Sep 18, 2013. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Ray Allen
item.description:
Evans Clinchy:LeBron on Ray Allen:

“I've always been in his ear over the years, telling him, 'Let's join together at some point. Let's join, join, join.'”

LeBron James on Ray Allen, Apr 26, 2013. Source: Twitter @evansclinchy.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Ray Allen
item.description:
Danny Ainge on whether he has spoken to Ray Allen since Allen has left Boston:

“I’ve tried to reach out to Ray. (Host: What’s been the reaction?)Ray doesn’t have the same number and I didn’t even realize that until recently but he hadn’t responded and I just thought he wasn’t responding.”

Danny Ainge on Ray Allen, Nov 6, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Ray Allen
item.description:
Doc Rivers on if he tried reaching out to Allen about coming back to Boston:

“I tried. I actually tried to call him. After the year we talked fine and then when free agency started Ray didn’t return Danny’s calls, didn’t return my calls. I stopped trying. Listen if you’ve been with me or our team for five years or four years and I have to call you every 10 seconds in free agency then you probably don’t want to be here.”

Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Oct 29, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Ray Allen
item.description:
Doc Rivers on his relationship with Ray Allen:

“I didn’t think it was bad, but maybe I’m the last to know. It didn’t help when I decided to start Avery (Bradley), obviously. But as a coach you make choices. You worry about people’s feelings but you worry more about the team. If anything, Ray probably didn’t like that. I’ll probably always look at myself first. Ray wanted the ball more, things like that. It’s like I tell my guys ever year, ‘If you’re here for me to run stuff for you look good then you are in the wrong place.’”

Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Oct 27, 2012. Source: NBCSports.com.
